description: Create a folder and move the given documents, folders, or tasks into it in one step. The folder is created under parentId, or at the matter root when parentId is null; a name already used there gets a numbered suffix. Refused as a whole, creating nothing, when the matter is at its entity limit, the parent is not a folder in this matter, an entity is not found or is read-only, or a folder would move into itself or one of its own descendants.
